---
title: "1_taggingAnalysis"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

To determine if there is a relationship between tagged status and:
* Water column position
* Taxonomy
* IUCN category

### Step 1: Load libraries

Load the libraries used.

```{r}
# Load tidyverse for sanity
library(tidyverse)

# Load scico 
library(scico)

# Load cowplot
library(cowplot)
```

### Step 2: Load files

```{r}
# Load shark trait data
sharkData <- read.csv("Data/SharkData/TraitData.csv")

# Load Matley tracking data
trackData <- read.csv("Supplementary_Material/Data/SharkData/Matley_TaggedSpecies.csv") %>%
  # Mutate species names to match trait data
  mutate(Genus_species = str_replace_all(species_fishbase, " ", "_")) %>%
  select(Genus_species, n.tagged, n.articles)
```

### Step 3: Append tracking data

```{r}
sharkJoined <- sharkData %>%
  # Use left_join
  left_join(trackData, by = "Genus_species") %>%
  mutate(Tracked = if_else(is.na(n.tagged), "No","Yes"))
```

### Step 4: Create contingency tables

```{r}
# Water Column Position
posTable <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(WaterColumnPosition, Tracked) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tracked, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

posMatrix <- posTable %>%
  column_to_rownames("WaterColumnPosition") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Family
famTable <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(Family, Tracked) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tracked, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

famMatrix <- famTable %>%
  column_to_rownames("Family") %>%
  as.matrix()

# IUCN Category
IUCNtable <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(IUCNcategory, Tracked) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Tracked, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

IUCNmatrix <- IUCNtable %>%
  column_to_rownames("IUCNcategory") %>%
  as.matrix()
```

### Step 5: Run chi-squared tests

```{r}
# Water Column Position
posTest <- chisq.test(posMatrix)
posTest$expected
posTest

# Family
famTest <- chisq.test(famMatrix)
famTest$expected
famTest
# Simulate p-values because of low family coverage
famTest2 <- chisq.test(famMatrix, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 5000)
famTest2$expected
famTest2

# IUCN Category
iucnTest <- chisq.test(IUCNmatrix)
iucnTest$expected
iucnTest
```

```{r}
# Create table of chi-squared results
results <- tibble(
  "Axis" = c("Water Column Position", "Family", "IUCN Category"),
  "Chi sq" = c(posTest$statistic, famTest2$statistic, iucnTest$statistic),
  "Degrees of Freedom" = c(posTest$parameter, famTest2$parameter, iucnTest$parameter),
  "p-value" = c(posTest$p.value, famTest2$p.value, iucnTest$p.value)
)

# Save chi-squared results as a csv
write.csv(results, "Supplementary_Material/Results/TableS1_Chi-squared.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

### Step 6: Make plots

```{r}
# Water Column Position
# Summarize observed counts
obs_WaterColumnPosition <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(WaterColumnPosition, Tracked) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Observed")

# Compute expected counts based on total species per WaterColumnPosition
total_tracked <- sum(sharkJoined$Tracked == "Yes")
total_species <- nrow(sharkJoined)

exp_WaterColumnPosition <- sharkJoined %>%
  group_by(WaterColumnPosition) %>%
  summarise(total_species = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    Yes = total_tracked * total_species / sum(total_species),
    No = total_species - Yes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(No, Yes), names_to = "Tracked", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Expected")

# Combine observed and expected
plot_WaterColumnPosition <- bind_rows(obs_WaterColumnPosition, exp_WaterColumnPosition)

# Stacked bar chart
posPlot <- ggplot(plot_WaterColumnPosition, aes(x = WaterColumnPosition, y = n, 
                                                 fill = Tracked)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkslategrey", 
                               "No" = "grey90")) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(y = "Total species", fill = "Tracked") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

posPlot
```

```{r}
# Family
# Summarize observed counts
obs_Family <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(Family, Tracked) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Observed")

# Compute expected counts based on total species per Family
total_tracked <- sum(sharkJoined$Tracked == "Yes")
total_species <- nrow(sharkJoined)

exp_Family <- sharkJoined %>%
  group_by(Family) %>%
  summarise(total_species = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    Yes = total_tracked * total_species / sum(total_species),
    No = total_species - Yes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(No, Yes), names_to = "Tracked", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Expected")

# Combine observed and expected
plot_Family <- bind_rows(obs_Family, exp_Family)

# Stacked bar chart
famPlot <- ggplot(plot_Family, aes(x = Family, y = n, fill = Tracked)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkslategrey", 
                               "No" = "grey90")) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(y = "Total species") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")

famPlot
```

```{r}
# IUCN Category
# Set order of categories
sharkJoined <- sharkJoined %>%
  mutate(IUCNcategory = factor(IUCNcategory, 
                               levels = c("DD", "LC", "NT", "VU", "EN", "CR")))

# Summarize observed counts
obs_IUCNcategory <- sharkJoined %>%
  count(IUCNcategory, Tracked) %>%
  mutate(Type = "Observed")

# Compute expected counts based on total species per IUCNcategory
total_tracked <- sum(sharkJoined$Tracked == "Yes")
total_species <- nrow(sharkJoined)

exp_IUCNcategory <- sharkJoined %>%
  group_by(IUCNcategory) %>%
  summarise(total_species = n()) %>%
  mutate(
    Yes = total_tracked * total_species / sum(total_species),
    No = total_species - Yes
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(No, Yes), names_to = "Tracked", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(Type = "Expected")

# Combine observed and expected
plot_IUCNcategory <- bind_rows(obs_IUCNcategory, exp_IUCNcategory)

# Stacked bar chart
catPlot <- ggplot(plot_IUCNcategory, aes(x = IUCNcategory, y = n, fill = Tracked)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "darkslategrey", 
                               "No" = "grey90"),
                    labels = c("Not Tagged", "Tagged")) +
  facet_wrap(~Type) +
  labs(fill = "Status") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5))

catPlot
```

Combine plots and save.

```{r}
# Arrange top row
top <- plot_grid(
  posPlot, catPlot, align = "h",
  labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = 8
)

FigureS1 <- plot_grid(
  top, famPlot,
  ncol = 1,
  labels = c("", "c"), label_size = 8
)

ggsave("Supplementary_Material/Results/FigS1.tiff",
       plot = FigureS1, units = "px",
       device = "tiff",
       width = 2100, height = 1500, dpi = 300)
```
